title: A Space website on its own domain serves its own sitemap and llms.txt, names its own entity, and its accent text and the Space menu pill read at AA

source.ref: Final stopping-point audit 2026-10-07 (owner ask: 'make sure the SEO/GEO is 100'). Read live through Vercel: https://danieltyack.com/sitemap.xml 404 (x-matched-path /hosted/[host]/[page]); danieltyack.com/llms.txt served Frequency's file; Lighthouse a11y 95 on the site home, 94 on /spaces/danieltyack.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: danieltyack.com's robots.txt named a sitemap that 404'd, because Next reads any `/sitemap.xml` path segment as a metadata route (its sitemap regex is unanchored, the robots one is anchored at the app root), so the rewrite to /hosted/<host>/sitemap.xml fell through to the [page] route; /contact was in no sitemap a crawler could read. The site's llms.txt was Frequency's, every link on frequencylocal.com. The only structured data on the site was Frequency's Organization and WebSite (root layout) plus Home's FAQ, so an answer engine had no node for the business itself. The Contact page reused Home's description, which ignored the Website intro. The Space profile's share card lost og:site_name and og:locale (its openGraph block replaced the root's). The site's accent words and step numbers drew the raw accent (#1eb6c5 on #f5eee2, 2.12:1), the Space menu's active pill drew the strong shade on the accent tint (4.35:1), and card titles skipped a heading level. THE FIX: lib/sites/host.ts maps each crawler file to its hosted route (/sitemap.xml to /site-sitemap, which re-exports the sitemap.xml handler; /llms.txt to /site-llms), and proxy.ts's host arm lets llms.txt through on site hosts. app/hosted/[host]/site-llms builds the site's llms.txt (lib/sites/seo.ts siteLlmsTxt) from its brand, Website intro and pages. SitePage emits siteEntitySchema (lib/jsonld.ts) on the site origin. siteMetadata describes a page with the Website intro and gives Contact its own line. The profile spreads OG_SITE and, with a site twin, brands the share card with the site and drops 'on Frequency.' from the snippet. house-css draws the accent words and step numbers in --color-primary-strong; the active menu pill draws ink on the tint; card titles are h3. LEFT: Frequency's Organization node still rides every site page from the root layout (moving it touches every Frequency layout, a fan-out change for its own PR), and app/sitemap.ts still lists /spaces/<slug> for a Space whose canonical is its site.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const host=r('lib/sites/host.ts');if(!/\\['\\/sitemap\\.xml', '\\/site-sitemap'\\]/.test(host)||!/export \\{ GET \\} from '\\.\\.\\/sitemap\\.xml\\/route'/.test(r('app/hosted/[host]/site-sitemap/route.ts')))miss.push('a site domain still rewrites /sitemap.xml to a metadata-route folder and 404s');if(!/\\['\\/llms\\.txt', '\\/site-llms'\\]/.test(host)||!/siteLlmsTxt\\(/.test(r('app/hosted/[host]/site-llms/route.ts'))||!r('proxy.ts').includes('|llms'+String.fromCharCode(92,92)+'.txt)'))miss.push('a site domain still serves Frequency llms.txt');const page=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx');if(!/<JsonLd data=\\{entity\\} \\/>/.test(page)||!/siteEntitySchema\\(/.test(page))miss.push('a site carries no structured data for its own entity');if(!/Contact \\\$\\{brandName\\}\\./.test(page)||!/readSiteHero\\(space\\.preferences\\)\\.tagline/.test(page))miss.push('the site Contact page repeats Home description and ignores the Website intro');if(!/\\.\\.\\.OG_SITE/.test(r('lib/spaces/profile-metadata.ts')))miss.push('the Space profile share card has no og:site_name or og:locale');const css=r('components/sites/house-css.ts');if(!/\\.hs-accent\\{[^}]*color:var\\(--color-primary-strong\\)/.test(css)||!/\\.hs-step-n\\{[^}]*color:var\\(--color-primary-strong\\)/.test(css))miss.push('the website accent words and step numbers fail contrast');if(/'bg-primary-bg text-primary-strong'/.test(r('components/spaces/space-profile-menu-view.tsx')))miss.push('the active Space menu pill fails contrast');if(miss.length){console.error('SCAN-813: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
